clauses.reason: The order revokes Executive Order No. 12691, which established the President's Advisory Committee on the Points of Light Initiative Foundation, after reciting that the Committee has completed its tasks. A self-executing revocation is performed when the order takes effect and needs no later act. The held text states no delayed effective date, so it took effect on its signing date, June 18, 1990; the Federal Register printed it in the June 20, 1990 issue, but publication is not the stated effective date and the alternative reading would place the effect on June 20, 1990. The command is therefore exhausted by performance on 1990-06-18, while the revocation of Executive Order No. 12691 survives as a consequence. The packet lookup of held texts citing this order by number found none.

research_rationale:
Identity confirmed against the census register (executive order of 1990-06-18 revoking Executive Order No. 12691) and the held Federal Register text at 55 FR 25295, whose text layer shows Vol. 55, No. 119, Wednesday, June 20, 1990. The order has one operative sentence, a revocation. Its command was performed on its own date, which is recorded as the first end; the revocation survives as a consequence and is recorded under savings.

savings.reason: The discontinuance of the Committee established by Executive Order No. 12691 is a lasting consequence of the performed revocation, and acts of that Committee before June 18, 1990 are accrued; the order contains no continuing command.
